name: Phoenix
short: Arize's open-source, local-first platform for LLM tracing, evaluation, experimentation, and prompt iteration (Phoenix Cloud managed hosting available).

plans.name: Free (Phoenix Cloud)
plans.notes: 25,000 trace spans per month, 1 GB ingestion, 15-day retention, unlimited users and evals; community support.

plans.name: Pro (Phoenix Cloud)
plans.notes: 50,000 trace spans per month, 10 GB ingestion, 30-day retention, email support.

plans.name: Self-hosted
plans.notes: Open-source Phoenix runs locally or on your own infra with full control over data location.
